characters.note: These are distinct action key poses, NOT continuous animation frames. Do not claim smooth animation or real eight-direction coverage. All images generated with built-in image_gen then alpha components normalized with one shared scale per atlas.

jiangshi.note: Attack feet are intentionally airborne above shared ground anchor. Do not rescale individual frames.

tiles.limits: Transparent RGBA verified; no in-engine seam or collision test. Normalize tile bounds after slicing before claiming seamless tiling.

decorations.layout: 4 columns x 2 rows; last cell empty; objects should be segmented by alpha bounds, not blindly cut at equal half-height
decorations.limits: Static sprites only. Fire and flag animation need separate animation/effects. No outside ground plane/cast shadows. World size and pivots to set after slicing.

environment.prompt_summary: Reference-only style: dark gothic wuxia, Hades-like handpainted high-contrast ink outlines, hard shadows, teal stone, red and antique gold accents. Fixed isometric camera. Tiles: 16 equal diamond surfaces separated by transparency. Decorations: seven isolated complete props plus one blank slot. Second decorations generation restored flame tip and transparent border.
